title: Gothic/Dark Academia
content: Apply gothic/dark academia aesthetic with intellectual darkness. Dark, muted colors: deep burgundy, forest green, navy, black, gold accents. Vintage academic imagery: books, libraries, classical architecture. Ornate serif typography. Include candles, ink, feathers as motifs. Antique paper textures. Gothic architectural elements: arches, columns. Mysterious, scholarly, romantic atmosphere. Victorian elegance meets academia.

variants.simple: Create moody gothic aesthetic with dark elegance, vintage academia, and mysterious atmosphere.
variants.detailed: Apply gothic/dark academia aesthetic with intellectual darkness. Dark, muted colors: deep burgundy, forest green, navy, black, gold accents. Vintage academic imagery: books, libraries, classical architecture. Ornate serif typography. Include candles, ink, feathers as motifs. Antique paper textures. Gothic architectural elements: arches, columns. Mysterious, scholarly, romantic atmosphere. Victorian elegance meets academia.
variants.advanced: Apply gothic/dark academia aesthetic with intellectual darkness and romantic decay. Color palette: deep burgundy (#800020), forest green (#013220), navy (#1a1a4e), charcoal (#36454f), with gold (#d4af37) and cream accents. Dark backgrounds with warm accent lighting. Textures: aged leather, antique paper (foxing spots, yellowed), velvet, dark wood grain. Academic imagery: stacked books, quill and ink, botanical illustrations, classical sculptures. Typography: elegant serifs (Playfair Display, Cormorant Garamond, Old Standard TT), blackletter for titles (Fraktur style), proper typographic details. Architectural elements: gothic arches (pointed arch shapes), columns, ornate moldings, library ladders. Candlelight: warm glow effects, flickering animation, wax drip details. Nature decay: pressed flowers, autumn leaves, ivy, moths. Patterns: damask, heraldic motifs, bookplate designs. Photography: moody, underexposed, vintage filter (sepia tint, vignette). Interactive: page turn effects, candlelight flicker, dust motes floating. Frame details: gilded frames, ornate borders, wax seals. Writing aesthetic: fountain pen strokes, handwritten margin notes. Books: leather spines, gold embossing, ribbon bookmarks. Implementation: layered textures, careful shadow work for mood. Accessibility: dark interface needs careful contrast ratios, ensure readability.
